delete.description: Delete a key from your Upstash Redis database. Returns deleted=false when the key did not exist.
delete.name: delete

parameters.description: The Redis key to operate on, for example 'user:42:session'.
parameters.name: key

deleted.description: True when the key existed and was removed; false when it did not exist.

get.description: Get the value stored at a key in your Upstash Redis database. Returns found=false when the key does not exist.
get.display_str_template: Get the value of Upstash key '{0}'.
get.name: get

parameters.description: The Redis key to operate on, for example 'user:42:session'.
parameters.name: key

key.description: The key that was looked up.

value.description: The stored value, or null when the key does not exist.

set.description: Store a value at a key in your Upstash Redis database, overwriting any existing value. Optionally have the key expire automatically after a number of seconds.
set.name: set

parameters.description: The Redis key to operate on, for example 'user:42:session'.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: The value to store for this key. Stored as text; convert numbers or JSON to text first if needed.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Optional. Automatically delete the key this many seconds after it is set (Redis EX). Leave blank to keep it until it is deleted.
parameters.name: ttl_seconds

success.description: True when the value was stored.

ttl_seconds.description: The expiry applied in seconds, or null when the key does not expire.

description: Read and write key-value data in your Upstash Redis database: get a key's value, set a value (with an optional expiry), and delete a key.
